description: Phase III (FRC) — pre-promotion quality gate. Scores .faf content (edge Mk4) + estimates tokens and returns a deterministic promote/hold verdict BEFORE it goes to a Grok Collection. Promote IFF score >= min_score AND tokens <= max_tokens (defaults 85/8000). Edge parity with the local gate; the hold-hint can't list empty slots at the edge.
name: faf_gate
title: FRC quality gate (promote/hold)
